description: This file defines the InstalledVersions class which provides metadata and version management functions for Composer-installed PHP packages. It includes methods for querying installed packages, their versions, and dependencies, and manages internal data about installed package sets.

classes.name: Composer\InstalledVersions
classes.description: Provides static methods to access information about installed Composer packages, including versions, dependencies, and package metadata.

methods.name: getInstalledPackages
methods.description: Returns a list of all installed package names, including replaced or provided packages.

methods.name: getInstalledPackagesByType
methods.description: Returns a list of installed packages filtered by a specific type, e.g., 'library'.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a specific package is installed, optionally including dev requirements.

methods.name: satisfies
methods.description: Checks if a package's installed version satisfies a given version constraint.

methods.name: getVersionRanges
methods.description: Retrieves version ranges for a specified package.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Gets the exact installed version of a package.

methods.name: getPrettyVersion
methods.description: Gets the human-readable version of an installed package.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the reference hash associated with a package.

methods.name: getInstallPath
methods.description: Returns the installation path of a package.

methods.name: getRootPackage
methods.description: Returns metadata about the root package of the project.

methods.name: getRawData
methods.description: Deprecated. Returns raw installed package data.

methods.name: getAllRawData
methods.description: Returns all raw datasets of installed packages.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the internal static data with custom installation data.
